issue.title: Offer live trigger completion for sase snippet show and delete
issue.description: Phase sase-rd.3 proposed catalog-backed completion candidates for the TRIGGER argument of sase snippet show/delete. The completion fast path currently forbids sase.xprompt imports, so these values remain unkinded rather than offering live triggers. Implement a completion-safe catalog projection or another no-heavy-import path that preserves completion latency.

task_type_fields.proposal: Offer live catalog-backed snippet trigger candidates for sase snippet show and sase snippet delete.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-rd delivered the documented CLI contract; dynamic shell completion was not part of its acceptance criteria and the completion fast path has an independent import/latency architecture constraint.

payload.close_reason: Implemented by 4a3e69196 ('add inventory and snippet candidate providers'). Both snippet show and snippet delete TRIGGER arguments map to ValueKind.SNIPPET; catalog_snippets.py calls the native load_editor_snippet_catalog binding, includes generated trigger aliases, and degrades safely on malformed/error payloads without importing sase.xprompt. The checked-in CLI snapshot carries the snippet kind. Candidate-provider, kind-mapping and snapshot tests passed in this review, so the requested completion-safe path already exists.
